name: Hornero Now Playing
description: Now Playing 2.0: compact bar indicator, details popover and dashboard card over the shared PluginKit Media (MPRIS) facade, with graceful no-player and idle-player states.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Compact bar indicator with host-owned details popover, dashboard card, typed settings, host-context layout and Spanish catalog, over the shared PluginKit Media facade.
Bar widget showing player identity, title and artist with inline previous, play/pause and next buttons.

showArtist.description: Show the track artist under the title when the player reports one.

showWhenNoPlayer.description: Keep the bar indicator visible, labelled as no player, when no media player is active.

maxTitleWidth.description: Maximum width in pixels for the track title in the bar.
